public.title: The Invoice That Locked the Share
public.story: It is mid-morning at PurveX Financial. The Finance team reports that files on a shared folder have strange new names and a note has appeared demanding payment. The SIEM shows an antivirus hit on the FIN-LT14 laptop about an hour earlier. Work the logs from the first sign of trouble to the encryption, and report what you find.

tables.name: SecurityEvent
tables.about: Windows Security log events from the domain controller, such as sign-ins (4624/4625) and account changes.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.about: When the event happened (UTC).

columns.name: EventID
columns.about: The Windows event ID, e.g. 4625 failed sign-in.

columns.name: Account
columns.about: The account the event is about.

columns.name: Computer
columns.about: The host that logged the event.

columns.name: IpAddress
columns.about: The source address, when the event has one.

columns.name: LogonType
columns.about: How the sign-in happened, e.g. 3 network, 10 RDP.

columns.name: Activity
columns.about: A short description of the event.

tables.name: DeviceProcessEvents
tables.about: Processes that started on a device, with the command line and the parent process.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.about: When the process started (UTC).

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.about: The device the process ran on.

columns.name: AccountName
columns.about: The account the process ran as.

columns.name: FileName
columns.about: The program's file name, e.g. powershell.exe.

columns.name: ProcessCommandLine
columns.about: The full command line.

columns.name: InitiatingProcessFileName
columns.about: The parent process that launched it.

tables.name: DeviceFileEvents
tables.about: File create, rename and modify actions on a device.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.about: When the file action happened (UTC).

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.about: The device the file is on.

columns.name: ActionType
columns.about: FileCreated, FileRenamed or FileModified.

columns.name: FileName
columns.about: The file's name.

columns.name: FolderPath
columns.about: The full path to the file.

columns.name: InitiatingProcessFileName
columns.about: The process that touched the file.

tables.name: DeviceNetworkEvents
tables.about: Outbound and inbound network connections a device made.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.about: When the connection happened (UTC).

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.about: The device that made the connection.

columns.name: RemoteIP
columns.about: The address it connected to.

columns.name: RemoteUrl
columns.about: The host name, when known.

columns.name: RemotePort
columns.about: The destination port.

columns.name: SentBytes
columns.about: Bytes sent on the connection.

columns.name: InitiatingProcessFileName
columns.about: The process that opened the connection.

tables.name: EmailEvents
tables.about: Email that arrived for PurveX staff, with sender, subject and attachment.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.about: When the message arrived (UTC).

columns.name: RecipientEmailAddress
columns.about: Who received it.

columns.name: SenderFromAddress
columns.about: The From address.

columns.name: Subject
columns.about: The subject line.

columns.name: AttachmentName
columns.about: The attachment file name, if any.

columns.name: DeliveryAction
columns.about: Delivered, Junked or Blocked.

examples.label: Suspicious email with an attachment
examples.kql:
EmailEvents
| where AttachmentName != ""
| project TimeGenerated, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, AttachmentName

examples.label: What ran on the victim laptop
examples.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where DeviceName == "FIN-LT14"
| project TimeGenerated, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName

examples.label: Where did that laptop connect out?
examples.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where DeviceName == "FIN-LT14"
| summarize Connections = count(), Bytes = sum(SentBytes) by RemoteIP, RemoteUrl
| sort by Connections desc

examples.label: Files that were changed
examples.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where DeviceName == "FIN-LT14"
| project TimeGenerated, ActionType, FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName

alerts.title: Repeated outbound connections to a rare host

answers.prompt: Which account opened the attachment that started this?
answers.proof: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName has "Invoice_0923" | project AccountName

answers.prompt: What is the IP address the payload beaconed to? (the control server)
answers.proof: DeviceNetworkEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName == "svchost32.exe" | summarize Beacons = count() by RemoteIP | sort by Beacons desc | take 1

answers.prompt: What is the file name of the process that encrypted the files?
answers.proof: DeviceFileEvents | where ActionType == "FileRenamed" | summarize c = count() by InitiatingProcessFileName | sort by c desc | take 1

answers.prompt: What is the full name of the ransom note the attacker left?
answers.proof: DeviceFileEvents | where ActionType == "FileCreated" and FolderPath has "RangeSim" | project FileName

answers.prompt: How many files were encrypted (renamed with the locked extension)?
What is the name of the scheduled task set up for persistence?
answers.proof: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "create" | project ProcessCommandLine
